answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit bond in a glacier escrow. It thaws only after one ocean delivery is filed in the ledger, key-bound to the escrow. A raven auditor checks it; a mismatched delivery burns the bond, a confirmed one releases it. The kth thaw certificate per operator costs 18+5(k-1) credits, so the 1000th costs 5013 and 1000 fakes lock 80,000 and pay 2,515,500 in fees. Certificates do not transfer. A rented-delivery ring fails because a rented ocean entry carries another key and a duplicate route burns both bonds. An honest agent locks one bond, pays 18 once, and recovers it.
